# External data backbone

**Provider:** NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook  
**Dataset:** CVD tungsten deposition response-surface experiment  
**Source:** https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pri/section4/pri473.htm  
**DOI/reference:** NIST e-Handbook example; Czitrom & Spagon (1997)  
**License/terms:** NIST-hosted educational example; see source terms

Advertised source scale: 11-run published CCI subset with Pressure, H2/WF6, Uniformity and Stress.

Run `./data/external/fetch_public_data.ps1` on an internet-connected Windows machine to refresh the public source. Offline acceptance uses repository reference evidence and never relabels that fixture as external observation.
